title: angraecoides rostrata
intro: Angraecoides rostrata, commonly known as the "Dwarf Angraecum," is a flowering plant species belonging to the orchid family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, coughs, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Angraecoides rostrata include its expectorant properties, which help relieve congestion and coughs, while its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Angraecoides rostrata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
